# Bad Court Positions Examples
# Demonstrates COURT-001 and COURT-002

# ERROR COURT-001: Missing can_be_appointed trigger
bad_court_001 = {
	# ERROR COURT-001: No can_be_appointed trigger
	# Should have: can_be_appointed = { is_adult = yes }

	salary = {
		gold = 2
	}

	opinion = {
		value = 10
	}

	aptitude = {
		value = {
			add = learning
			multiply = 0.5
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}
}

# ERROR COURT-002: Has salary but no opinion modifier
bad_court_002 = {
	can_be_appointed = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	salary = {
		gold = 2
	}

	# ERROR COURT-002: Salary defined but no opinion block
	# Should have: opinion = { value = 10 }

	aptitude = {
		value = {
			add = stewardship
			multiply = 0.5
		}
	}
}

# Multiple errors combined
bad_court_all = {
	# ERROR COURT-001: Missing can_be_appointed

	salary = {
		gold = 3
	}

	# ERROR COURT-002: Has salary but no opinion

	aptitude = {
		value = {
			add = diplomacy
			multiply = 0.5
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}
}

# Edge case: Empty can_be_appointed (still technically present)
bad_court_empty_trigger = {
	can_be_appointed = {
	}

	salary = {
		gold = 1
	}

	opinion = {
		value = 5
	}
}

# Edge case: Only aptitude defined, no can_be_appointed
bad_court_aptitude_only = {
	# ERROR COURT-001: No can_be_appointed trigger
	# Should have: can_be_appointed = { is_adult = yes }

	aptitude = {
		value = {
			add = intrigue
			multiply = 0.5
		}
	}
}

# Edge case: Salary with complex cost but still no opinion
bad_court_complex_salary = {
	can_be_appointed = {
		is_adult = yes
		martial >= 10
	}

	salary = {
		round = yes
		gold = 5
	}

	# ERROR COURT-002: Complex salary defined but no opinion block
	# Should have: opinion = { value = 15 }

	is_shown = {
		has_royal_court = yes
	}
}
